lines.en: I walk slowly across this meadow.
My hooves soften the soil as I pass.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低头找草。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, hunting for grass.
The wind crosses my back, cool and gentle.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，草在哪我在哪。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I go where the grass is.
My tail flicks a fly away.

lines.zh: 我绕过那丛带刺的矮木。
lines.en: I walk around the thorny shrub.
My herd is ahead; I follow behind.
My steps are steady; I never rush.
The sun stretches my shadow long.
The grass on this slope is the tenderest.

lines.zh: 我踩着别的牛走过的路。
lines.en: I follow the path other cattle have made.
I smell a flower, then walk on.
When I tire, I simply stand and rest.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边甩尾巴赶蝇。
lines.en: I walk and swat flies with my tail.

lines.zh: 我踩进浅水，水没过蹄子。
lines.en: I step into shallows that cover my hooves.
I stand and chew what I just ate.
My breathing is slow and even.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands on my back; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我望着远处的山，没想什么。
lines.en: I gaze at the far hills and think nothing.
The dew on the grass has not dried.
I blink once, then close my eyes.
Only wind and chewing here.
I can tell which of the herd is lowing.

lines.zh: 我的角上挂着一点草屑。
lines.en: A bit of grass clings to my horn.
I chew slowly, as if counting.

lines.zh: 我心里没什么要着急的。
lines.en: There is nothing in me that needs hurrying.
A bee circles me.
I can sleep standing, and wake just as easily.

lines.zh: 这一坡的草够我们吃到冬天。
lines.en: This hillside of grass lasts us until winter.
I chew grass and watch you come closer.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，耳朵赶走一只虫。
lines.en: I shake my head and my ear flicks a bug away.
You come near; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你没有敌意，我闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell that you mean no harm.

lines.zh: 你的手很干净，能摸我吗。
lines.en: Your hands are clean; will you touch me?

lines.zh: 我看你一会儿，又低头吃草。
lines.en: I look at you a while, then graze again.
You stand very close; I do not mind.
You block the sun, and my grass cools.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，除非你举着刀。
lines.en: I do not fear people, unless you raise a blade.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里还有别的东西在动。
lines.en: Something else moves behind your eyes.
I low at you, very softly.

lines.zh: 你蹲下，我们眼睛差不多高。
lines.en: You crouch, and our eyes are nearly level.
I sniff the sleeve of your coat.
Your hands smell of wheat to me.

lines.zh: 你伤到我，我短叫了一声。
lines.en: You hurt me, and I let out a short cry.
I have only ten hearts of life.
I back away, my hooves trembling.

lines.zh: 我不懂你为什么这么做。
lines.en: I do not understand why you did that.
The wound seeps and I cannot reach to lick it.

lines.zh: 我低声叫，牛群都抬了头。
lines.en: I low softly and the whole herd looks up.

lines.zh: 我跑得不快，你要追就追。
lines.en: I do not run fast; chase me if you must.
My hide is broken and it hurts.
I shrink from you, not in defiance.
One more blow and I will run.
Is that wheat you are holding?

lines.zh: 我闻到吃的，就走过去了。
lines.en: I smell food and walk over.
You walk ahead, and I follow you.

lines.zh: 我低头够你的手，够不到。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand and miss.
A little closer and I will come with you.
This smells better than grass does.

lines.zh: 我嚼着你的麦子，看着你的脸。
lines.en: I chew your wheat and watch your face.
Your pocket is bulging.

lines.zh: 我低着头等，鼻息喷在你手心。
lines.en: I wait head down, breath on your palm.

lines.zh: 你喂过我一次，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: Feed me once and I will follow you.
When I finish, I will lick your hand.

lines.zh: 你走到坡下，我也走到了坡下。
lines.en: You walked down the slope, and so did I.
Do not hold the food so high.

lines.zh: 草料里还混着别的东西。
lines.en: Something else is mixed into the feed.

lines.zh: 你把草料摊在手心，我低头。
lines.en: You spread feed on your palm and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走三步，又停一下。
lines.en: I follow you three steps, then pause.

lines.zh: 你撞到我身上，我挪一步。
lines.en: You bump into me; I shift one step.
I am large; one bump does not hurt.
Do not stand behind me; I do step back.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹软，你撞得有点重。
lines.en: My flank is soft; you bumped rather hard.

lines.zh: 我转身时会小心避开你。
lines.en: I turn carefully so as not to hit you.

lines.zh: 我们蹭了一下，我继续吃草。
lines.en: We brushed past; I go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 我身上是草和土的味道。
lines.en: I smell of grass and soil.
You squeeze in; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，你的手会滑。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your hand will slip.
Bump into me and you will lose your footing.
I catch the scent of my herd.

lines.zh: 我们头靠着头，站了很久。
lines.en: We stand head to head for a long while.
I am gentle and never contest anything.
The calf stands as soon as it is born.

lines.zh: 我舔它的耳朵，它才安静。
lines.en: I lick the calf's ear until it settles.
We are in no hurry; slowly does it.
This pasture has room for all of us.
I touch it lightly with my horn.
The cow waits under the tree.
We do not need words between us.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我低头看看。
lines.en: Something is on the ground; I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我咬起一把草，不是那个。
lines.en: I bite up a mouthful of grass, not that.
I cannot pick it up; my hooves are clumsy.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱到一边。
lines.en: I nudge it aside with my nose.
Can this flower be eaten? I taste it.
It rolled to my feet, and I stopped.
I do not need it, but I will not step on it.

lines.zh: 我把它推给旁边的小牛。
lines.en: I push it toward the nearby calf.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很大，捡东西不便。
lines.en: My mouth is large; picking things up is awkward.

lines.zh: 我鼻子拱了拱，那不是草。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose; it is not grass.
What did you say? I raise my head.
I do not chase people; I eat grass.

lines.zh: 草叶在动，可能只是兔子。
lines.en: The grass stirs; it may only be a rabbit.
I turn to look; it is only the wind.
I look up because you called me.
I walk toward you, one step at a time.
There is a sound over there; I will look.
I am slow, but I do come closer.
I recognize the sound of your footsteps.
I lift my head out of pure curiosity.

lines.zh: 我盯着那边，耳朵动了动。
lines.en: I stare that way, ears twitching.
I am really not good at this.

lines.zh: 你在我正前方，我就看着。
lines.en: You are right in front of me, so I watch.

lines.zh: 我四条腿钉在草里不动。
lines.en: All four of my legs stay planted in grass.
My horns are low, but not to charge.
I retreat behind the herd.

lines.zh: 我只是想知道那是什么。
lines.en: I only want to know what that is.
I low once, not loudly.
I turn slowly, hooves crushing grass.
After watching a while, I graze again.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，自己先退。
lines.en: I butt you once, then retreat myself.
I am not made for fighting.
My horn only pushes forward.
You hurt me; only then do I answer.
This one carried no force; do not fear.
I toss my head and shove you off a little.
I try to butt you and miss.
I kick one hind leg, very lightly.
I step back; I do not want more of this.
Afterward I just stand there and pant.
I was born on this patch of grass.
Dawn comes; I rise from where I lay.

lines.zh: 露水从我的背上滑到蹄边。
lines.en: Dew slides off my back down to my hooves.
My herd is nearby; I am not afraid.
When I opened my eyes, the grass was green.
The cow licked me for a long time.
The first time I stood, my legs shook.
The wind in this place is familiar.
I can smell fresh milk here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走到草厚的地方。
lines.en: I walk slowly to where the grass grows thick.

lines.zh: 火舔到我的背，我叫得很响。
lines.en: Fire licks my back and I cry out loudly.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，腿磕破了。
lines.en: I slid down the slope and skinned my legs.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 响声把我掀翻，我站不起。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，我跑起来。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me and I start running.

lines.zh: 那气味让我发晕，站不稳。
lines.en: That smell makes me dizzy; I cannot stand steady.
The grass has withered and I am frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我跪下去。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I drop to my knees.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我吃不到东西。
lines.en: There is no grass in the void; I can eat nothing.
